messages:
emily: kicking off a quick security validation for the eu5 GPU cluster bring-up. want to confirm IAM/service-account mapping, keystore/KMS bindings, and secret rotations before handoff.
raj: SGTM. I ran the provisioning scripts earlier — nodes healthy, k8s Ready=50/50 due to one tainted node.
sylvie: taint fix already in my queue, will drain+relabel in a few. do we have the KMS key resource name we should use for this region?
emily: using projects/redwood-prod/locations/europe-west6/keyRings/eu5-keys/cryptoKeys/eu5-infer-key for now. note: customer IT asked for HSM-backed key; this key is on CloudHSM.
raj: good. for IAM, we need the following minimal roles:
- serviceAccount: redwood-eu5-infer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the key
- roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor for secrets used by runtime
- roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator for the control-plane impersonation flow
emily: + make sure only the dedicated infra project and ops-runner SA have IAM policies to impersonate that SA. no broad org-wide grants.
sylvie: copying the validation commands I'm about to run:
```
# check KMS access
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy eu5-infer-key \
  --keyring=eu5-keys --location=europe-west6 --project=redwood-prod

# test encrypt/decrypt as service account
gcloud auth activate-service-account redwood-eu5-infer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --key-file=/tmp/sa.json
printf 'test' > /tmp/p
gcloud kms encrypt --location=europe-west6 --keyring=eu5-keys --key=eu5-infer-key --plaintext-file=/tmp/p --ciphertext-file=/tmp/c
gcloud kms decrypt --location=europe-west6 --keyring=eu5-keys --key=eu5-infer-key --ciphertext-file=/tmp/c --plaintext-file=/tmp/d
cat /tmp/d
```
raj: also check Secret Manager replication policy (multi-region or regional) — for eu5 we prefer regional secrets unless cross-region workload requires it.
emily: agreed. ops note: secret versions must be labeled with rotation metadata, and we should rotate any bootstrap secrets that were generated during provisioning.
deploy-bot: deploy 1876543299 to infra/eu5 completed :white_check_mark: (image: runtime-v2.1.3)
michael: small networking reminder — Private Google Access and restricted egress rules must allow HSM gateway to reach cloudhsm endpoints; proxy rules exist in the eu5 firewall group. confirmed with net-team.
ops-runner: ran smoke harness against runtime — GPU jobs schedule and pull weights ok, but KV cache warmup fails intermittently (timeout 3s). logging points to secret fetch delays at startup.
sylvie: that points to secret fetch QoS. I'll add a small retry backoff and increase initial token TTL for the SA while we debug.
emily: before handoff, can we get an explicit checklist? I want signoff on: IAM least-privilege, KMS/HSM binding verified, secrets rotated, firewall rules confirmed, node taint cleared, and smoke run green.
raj: will create a quick PR with the checklist and include the gcloud commands + logs in the runbook.
emily: thumbs. tagging @michael for network signoff and @ops-runner for final smoke pass.
michael: network signoff: firewall and proxy rules good, HSM reachability verified at 1876543700.
ops-runner: smoke: passed at 1876543860. KV cache warmup resolved after retry patch. handing off to oncall for production hardening. :rocket:
emily: perfect — handing off. adding the PR link and a short writeup to the eng-infra runbook. thanks team!
